results.name: Prism Core Valley Procedural Sci-Fi Environment
results.description:
A colorful, 60-metre sci-fi reactor set in a remote mountain valley. Glowing energy rings, metallic conduits, and layered cooling fins rise above a concrete pedestal, surrounded by pine trees, worker buildings, and parked cars that establish its enormous scale.
This first Sketchfab test explores an AI-assisted procedural workflow: art direction by Jon Tojek, with Blender Python scripts developed using OpenAI Codex. Geometry, materials, and lighting were assembled programmatically and exported as GLB for real-time viewing.
An early look-development study focused on color, scale, and browser-based presentation. Orbit around the facility and zoom in to find the workers beside the entrance stairs.

results.name: The_ROYAL_Enfield 1879 Box
results.description:
Lo, upon a table of carved oak there rested a casket of such rare workmanship as might draw the gaze of kings and princes alike. Fashioned from the finest timber of ancient forests, its polished surface gleamed with a warm and noble lustre, each grain flowing as though painted by Nature’s own hand. Bands of beaten gold embraced its corners and edges, wrought with delicate filigree of vines, crowns, and heraldic beasts, their forms catching the candlelight like captured stars. Upon its lid were set golden emblems of regal majesty, engraved with such exquisite care that no mortal craftsman seemed equal to the task. The hinges moved in silence smooth as a whispered vow, and the box itself bore an air of wealth, honour, and mystery, as though it concealed treasures fit for an emperor’s ransom. Verily, it was no common chest, but a jewel amongst vessels, worthy to stand within the chambers of sovereigns and command the admiration of all who beheld it.


And indeed it is, free to download and reap.

results.name: Stylized Cable Reel – Tier I
results.description: A powerful Stylized Cable Reel, inspired by the robust and functional aesthetics of North African utility and construction. Its distressed wooden planks, held together with visible, rustic bolts, showcase a rich tapestry of weathered textures and dark stains, reflecting the harsh yet beautiful environments of the Maghreb. The pronounced wood grain and practical design embody the enduring character of well-used equipment, seamlessly blending into stylized desert towns or industrial zones. Crafted with AI and optimized for real-time use, this Tier I asset is ideal for Game environments. Perfect for stylized exteriors, infrastructure nodes, or lore-rich overlays. Shared freely to empower creators and celebrate open-access artistry.

results.name: Decaying Prison Cell Interior
results.description:
**Realistic Detention Room 3D Model (Blender + Cycles)"**
A highly detailed, atmospheric 3D model of a dilapidated prison cell, rendered in Blender using Cycles. Features include:
Authentic weathered corrugated metal walls with peeling green paint, rust stains, and corrosion
Functional interior elements: metal-framed cot with striped mattress, vintage wooden chair, barred door, and hanging industrial lamp
Realistic concrete floor texture with dirt, stains, and subtle wear

Ideal for cinematic scenes, horror/thriller games, architectural storytelling, VR escape rooms, or historical reconstructions. Ready for animation, lighting studies, or integration into larger environments.

If you require any modifications, please email me at
esmdesign8@gmail.com

results.name: Kapal Penangkap Ikan Industri
results.description:
Highly detailed industrial fishing vessel, heavy-duty commercial fishing boat, realistic 3D model, rugged engineering design inspired by heavy machinery. Large steel hull with visible weld seams, reinforced metal plates, functional crane arm for nets, hydraulic winches, thick industrial cables, rotating radar antenna, satellite dome, lifeboats on the side, weathered paint with rust and salt corrosion details, realistic ocean wear and tear.

Modular deck layout with fishing equipment: large fishing nets rolled on drums, fish storage containers, ice boxes, mechanical pulley system, metal railings, safety lights, exhaust pipes with smoke stains. Cabin with glass windows, navigation controls, spotlight lamps, antennas, ladders, and safety signage.

PBR textures, ultra-realistic materials, 8K texture resolution, realistic metal roughness, scratches, chipped paint, wet surface reflections. High-poly 3D model, game-ready topology but cinematic quality.

results.name: Free Game-Ready Waste Container Model
results.description:
**Free for any use. Attribution required: Made by LQC.**

Model has been created with Blender©. Textures were made and baked using Adobe Substance Painter.

A vertical green industrial waste container designed for urban and service environments. The surface is heavily worn and dirty, covered with stains, scratches, and accumulated grime that reflect prolonged outdoor use. The paint is faded in places, with subtle damage and scuff marks around high-contact areas.

The container features a functional construction: the lid and wheels are modeled as separate objects, all properly parented to the main body, making the asset ready for animation, interaction, or physics setup. All parts are cleanly structured and use clear, logical naming for easy scene organization.

Game-ready asset optimized for real-time use, including three Levels of Detail (LODs) for performance efficiency across different distances.

results.name: Rusty Electric Meter Box Mounted on a Tree
results.description: 3D photogrammetry model of an old metal electric meter box mounted directly onto a tree trunk with metallic straps. The box is heavily rusted and shows signs of long-term outdoor exposure, with orange and brown corrosion marks across its surface. A clear inspection window reveals an electric meter labeled “Energo-Pro.” The lower section has torn paper labels with Georgian text and faded numbers. The metal surface texture is rough, featuring rust stains, scratches, and peeling paint. The surrounding tree bark, visible straps, and electrical cables add realism to the setup, representing a makeshift installation typical in urban and rural post-Soviet environments. Ideal for realistic street or infrastructure scenes, visual storytelling, or texturing studies. Scanned with iPhone 12 Pro using lidar and iphonescan technology. Reference for realistic urban environment.

results.name: Rusty Metal Electric Meter Box on Wall
results.description: 3D photogrammetry model of a rusty outdoor electric meter box mounted on a textured concrete wall in Tbilisi, Georgia. The metal box is covered in corrosion, cracks, and faded graffiti markings. Its front panel has a small glass window showing an old analog electric meter inside. The surface displays layers of rust, peeled paint, and weather stains, giving it a worn, industrial appearance. White paint drips and black scribbles add to the urban aesthetic, while the surrounding wall and metal support frame emphasize the post-Soviet street atmosphere. This model is a realistic urban asset ideal for environment design, capturing the look of aged public infrastructure in city settings. Scanned with iPhone 12 Pro using lidar and iphonescan technology. Reference for realistic street urban environment.
